The current RBI repo rate is 5.50%, following the Monetary Policy Committee \(MPC\) decision on October 7, 2026, where it was raised by 25 basis points from 5.25%. [0]

You can review the updated breakdown of the reserve and lending rates set by the [Reserve Bank of India](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESUQHrOzAV1g8hIiWI454zfmdtVHhaqXHcafB-L4p5dhnNCsDc4NLn4I6TI1vrQbo7YSmyffzzMeGjy8zGS3-IY1eFQx9eOsujwJMYL38ZB7yK3A) below:

| Rate Category | Current Percentage |
| --- | --- |
| Policy Repo Rate | 5.50% |
| Standing Deposit Facility \(SDF\) Rate | 5.25% |
| Marginal Standing Facility \(MSF\) Rate | 5.75% |
| Bank Rate | 5.75% |
| Reverse Repo Rate | 3.35% |

If you'd like, I can set up a task to alert you when the next RBI Monetary Policy Committee meeting results are announced in December 2026.
